They just pin up the essay, with a coin taped to the corner.} Take the hour, and the coin {An hour of commas and confusion. The essay improves; so does your purse, slightly.|You take them through it line by line. They pay, and thank you twice.|You know their mistakes before they make them now. The hour goes quickly, and they pay.} Help, and leave the coin pinned {You leave the coin taped to the board. The essay comes back with a good mark, and the first-year tells everyone.|You help for nothing. They try to pay you anyway, and you won't let them.|You leave the coin where it is, as always. Somebody has drawn a small sun beside the notice.}
